title: Yara and the Wolf
premise: Paloma Almeida survives the royal court by tasting poison and keeping the ledgers of the Guild of Impossible Things, a trade in souls, favors, and forgotten names. When the old gods stir beneath the mountain, he learns his sister Yara's soul was sold to the court there years ago, and the god who wears a wolf's shape offers him the truth at a terrible price. As the court's poisoners close in and the guild's masters demand his silence, Paloma must choose between the loyalty that kept him invisible and the truth that will burn everything down. In the end he trades his own immunity, and nearly his own soul, to buy Yara back, unmaking the guild's ledgers and waking the old gods to judge the court that profited.
about_author: Juniper Ashgrove is a former apothecary's apprentice from a coastal town famous for its fog and its feuds. She writes fantasy about people who bargain with things too large to love them back.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. He tastes the king's supper, catalogs the slow arsenic in the stew, and files it away without accusation. We see his invisibility as craft: a man trained to notice everything and say nothing. Emotional beat: the loneliness of a life built on swallowing danger in silence.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. By night he keeps the guild's ledgers, entries for traded years, borrowed luck, and one soul sold under a name he almost recognizes. His mentor Vess warns him never to read the entries aloud. Emotional beat: creeping unease as duty and curiosity begin to war.

chapters.title: Prayers Answered
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. A kitchen girl's prayer to a forgotten god is answered with impossible abundance, and the court whispers of old power stirring beneath the mountain. Paloma feels the ledger's ink shift on its own. Emotional beat: wonder shadowed by dread that the world's rules are breaking.

chapters.title: The Wolf at the Well
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. A great grey wolf with a man's patient eyes speaks to him at the well, calling him by his childhood name. It claims to know who sold his sister Yara's soul. Emotional beat: terror braided with desperate hope, the first crack in his careful silence.

chapters.title: Yara, Missing
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV, with a memory interlude. He searches the guild's oldest volumes and finds Yara's entry, sold by their father to pay a debt, buyer: the Court Beneath the Mountain. Emotional beat: grief and fury at learning his invisibility was purchased with her.

chapters.title: The Price of Truth
chapters.summary: The wolf's POV. The wolf, an old god bound in wolf-shape, explains the bargain it offers: it will open the road below, but Paloma must carry a truth into the court that will destroy his protector, Lord Cassel. Emotional beat: the seduction and corruption of power offered freely.

chapters.title: Poison at the Feast
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. At a state feast he detects poison meant not for the king but for the guild's envoys, and must choose to expose it and become visible. He speaks, and the hall goes silent. Emotional beat: the exhilarating, frightening cost of being seen.

chapters.title: Vess's Warning
chapters.summary: Vess's POV. Vess reveals she helped broker Yara's sale to save the guild from ruin, and begs Paloma to let the dead bargains lie. Emotional beat: loyalty strained by guilt; love expressed as a plea for cowardice.

chapters.title: Descent
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Guided by the wolf, he enters the mountain road, where prayers echo as physical light and the guild's debts hang in the air like chains. Emotional beat: awe curdling into horror at what his world was built upon.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. He walks the subterranean court of the old gods' jailers, where Yara's soul serves as a living candle. He must not look at her too long, or the court will notice. Emotional beat: aching tenderness and self-erasure, invisibility as both skill and wound.

chapters.title: A Name Spoken
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. Yara, half-dissolved into the court's service, feels her brother's gaze and begins, for the first time in years, to remember her name. Emotional beat: fragile rekindling of selfhood.

chapters.title: The Bargain Refused
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The court offers him Yara's freedom in exchange for the wolf's true name. Paloma realizes the court wants the old gods' jailer unbound for its own corrupt purposes. Emotional beat: the corruption of power laid bare; refusal at great personal cost.

chapters.title: Cassel's Fall
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. He delivers the wolf's truth about Cassel to the court above, and his protector is destroyed, exactly as promised. Paloma gains access but loses his last shield. Emotional beat: guilt and the bitter taste of being an instrument.

chapters.title: Ledger-Burning
chapters.summary: Vess's POV. The guild's masters order Paloma's execution for treason against the trade. Vess burns his page in the ledger, erasing his debts and, she fears, his protections. Emotional beat: loyalty chosen over the institution that demanded it.

chapters.title: The Wolf Unbound
chapters.summary: The wolf's POV. The court, cheated, moves to bind the wolf forever. The wolf asks Paloma not to save it, but to free it, knowing a free old god may not stay gentle. Emotional beat: trust as a leap into the dark.

chapters.title: Stealing a Soul
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Using his taster's craft, he poisons the court's warding flame with a single drop of his own accumulated immunity, snuffing it, and lifts Yara's soul-candle from its stand. Emotional beat: quiet triumph, every swallowed poison finally purposeful.

chapters.title: The Long Way Up
chapters.summary: Paloma and Yara's alternating POV. They flee the collapsing road while the court hunts them, and Yara, barely herself, asks whether he came for love or for guilt. Emotional beat: reconciliation through hard honesty.

chapters.title: What the Gods Demand
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The freed wolf meets them at the mountain's mouth and demands its price: a soul for a soul. Yara offers herself back; Paloma refuses and offers his own immunity, the thing that kept him alive and invisible. Emotional beat: love against duty resolved in sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Judgment of the Old Gods
chapters.summary: Multiple POV. The unbound gods rise and summon the court above to account, ledgers and all. The guild's masters, the king's poisoners, and the subterranean court are judged as their debts are read aloud. Emotional beat: terrible, cleansing reckoning.

chapters.title: Aftertaste
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Powerless now, his tongue ordinary, Paloma recovers in Vess's kitchen while Yara slowly relearns being human. The guild's ledgers are ash. Emotional beat: the strange peace of an unguarded life.

chapters.title: Yara and the Wolf
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. Yara, whole again, walks the hills where the wolf now runs free and unbound, neither pet nor prisoner. She and Paloma begin a new trade: returning what the guild stole, name by name. Emotional beat: loyalty and truth finally aligned.

chapters.title: One Dish at a Time
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV, epilogue. Paloma cooks a simple meal for his sister, tasting nothing for anyone's safety but their own. A prayer he whispers is answered, softly, by something kind. Emotional beat: hard-won hope; invisibility exchanged for belonging.
